features.description: Keep traffic recorded before an inbound is disabled while preventing later stale counter changes from being attributed to that node.

Counter changes reported after an inbound is disabled do not increase today's totals.
Enabled inbound traffic continues to be aggregated.
The dashboard reflects the corrected daily node traffic without browser errors.

features.name: Improve 3x-ui request resilience
features.description: Retry a timed-out panel request once and reduce background polling pressure.
done_criteria: A timed-out 3x-ui request is automatically attempted one more time.
Non-timeout failures are not retried.
Direct and standalone 3x-ui service transports share the same retry behavior.
Background inbound monitoring defaults to a two-minute interval without overlapping an active refresh.
verification: 2026-09-08: Regression coverage confirmed an AbortError is retried exactly once and the second attempt succeeds.
2026-09-08: Default background inbound polling was reduced from every 30 seconds to every 2 minutes; npm run verify:fast and git diff --check passed.

features.name: Synchronize only changed package inbounds
features.description: Apply package-group inbound additions and removals with the matching bulk API while keeping client groups on the single-client update path.
done_criteria: An add-only package change calls only bulkAttach.
A remove-only package change calls only bulkDetach.
A mixed change waits for bulkAttach before bulkDetach.
Package-group synchronization never calls groups/bulkAdd.
Existing client groupName changes use clients/update/{email}.
verification: 2026-09-09: Payment-chain regression coverage passed add-only, remove-only, mixed ordered synchronization, absence of groups/bulkAdd, and groupName replacement through clients/update/{email}.
2026-09-09: npm run verify passed application/docs builds and core, 3x-ui, payment-chain, and wallet tests.

features.name: Audit active self-hosted client groups
features.description: Use the effective activeGroup to repair mismatched 3x-ui client groupName values during the five-minute traffic task.
done_criteria: The legacy daily subscription-pool refresh timer is removed while explicit refresh endpoints remain available.
Every five-minute traffic sync audits active self-hosted users against the clients/list snapshot and repairs existing groupName mismatches.
activeGroup is preferred over group; renewals and direct plan changes replace both fields, while the detail-page permission action changes activeGroup only.
Provisioning retries timeout failures at most three attempts and does not retry ordinary failures.
verification: 2026-09-11: Regression assertions cover activeGroup precedence, group fallback, missing-group rejection, and structured XUI timeout errors.
